question:
Identify the ANTONYM of the following word in the given sentence.

Divulge

The culprit surprised everyone by opting to conceal the secret execution of his plans even after getting beaten by the police.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Conceal**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Divulge **means to tell something that is secret (**गुप्‍त बात बताना, (रहस्‍य) प्रकट करना)**

 
 
• **Example**- The phone companies refused to divulge details of their costs.
 
 
 
• **Conceal **means to hide, withdraw or remove from observation, cover or keep from sight. (**छिपाना**)
 
 
• **Example**- He concealed the gun under his coat.
 
 
 
• It is clear from the above explanation that the correct answer is '**Conceal**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Opting **means to choose or choose to do something. (**चुनना**)
 
• **Execution **means the act or process of executing. (**कार्यान्वयन**)
 
• **Culprit **means someone who has committed a crime or done something wrong. (**अपराधी**)
